recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-47966 unless a future terminology decision changes the THO value set contents or canonical URL.
issue_request: FHIR-47966 was Applied with resolution Persuasive with Modification. The original ballot comment suggested making ImagingSelection.code and ImagingSelection.category at least Preferred, but the final resolution directed creation of the Image Reference Type value set in THO and updating ImagingSelection.code to a Preferred binding to that value set.
initial_application: The ImagingSelection.category Preferred binding had already been applied through FHIR-48095/FHIR-48097. The FHIR-47966-specific code binding was applied in git commit 94a7db89527edb832d1a65c94d28b713c0353dba and merged by PR 3982, changing ImagingSelection.code from an example DICOM CID 7010 binding to a preferred binding on http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/image-reference-type.
additional_context: ImagingSelection is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. UP-741 implemented the supporting THO Image Reference Type value set, and the live terminology page exposes the same canonical URL used by the StructureDefinition. Related FHIR-48095 and FHIR-48097 are already represented on the combined branch and explain why no additional category edit belongs in this seed.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source already binds ImagingSelection.code with Preferred strength to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/image-reference-type, and ImagingSelection.category is already Preferred to the DICOM Key Object Selection Document Title value set.

related_jiras.note: Implemented the THO Image Reference Type value set that FHIR-47966 depends on.

Separately audited that ImagingSelection.category is already Preferred and needs no additional source change.
